verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents at least one autonomous background automation: the GitHub AI Writer watches pull requests and proposes doc updates when code changes affect docs. Bi-directional sync also keeps ReadMe and a Git repo in sync automatically, and the ReadMe API and rdme CLI allow programmatic control that could be scripted externally. These are fixed, purpose-built automations rather than a general facility for users to define their own; the Docs Audit appears to be a one-pass run with no evidence of scheduling. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduled or triggered runs (e.g. recurring audits), autonomous agent actions beyond proposing PR-driven updates, and independent hands-on corroboration.
